race.comment: On to our feature race where star mare SHEZA ALIBI (12) will take all the beating. The stable pitched her up to Sydney first up to take on Autumn Glow and that mare was just a bit too professional but she stormed home for a clear second in a high-rating race. Her Doncaster win in the Autumn was that of a champion and 1600m on the big track here from a middle draw should see her explode. SIR DELIUS (4) resumes. His two fresh runs at this trip have been very good. He'll be peaking later over further but is too good to ignore and he's been trialling very well. MR BRIGHTSIDE (1) is aiming for a historic four-peat in this race. Led at a crawl to win it last year but still did so and he was game as ever fresh in the Memsie off a long spell. Maps ideally and will probably hit the front at some point. TREASURETHE MOMENT (10) had the right run in the Memsie but ran well and has claims.
